comments.author: Laurena
comments.body: After sitting in seville and stalking Elysium members trying to get a town register, i finally found one (sorry if i broke any protocols but i didnt ask). Anyway, i sailed over with the hull and parts, and the option to build it as a normal ship was there, but not FS. I am a r17 Sber, so unless it requires r18 or more, i doubt it can be built with FS yet. I did build it as a normal type ship, and added the parts in after. Same result really, it just needed a few permits. So i am guessing that you can build this, but just not through the FS building.

comments.author: WW
comments.body: Would this be a good shipwreck ship? Or does it have to little sailors to be effective?

comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
Too little sailors. Not only that, but from what I understand, light ships have a hard time salvaging standard and especially heavy ships. So you'd want a heavy ship to salvage with for certain.

I suggest you get the San Gabriel. It's got better crew, Haul Assist, EA, and Reference Room, the only non-astro ship to have it. It can also have a total of 9 mods!
